news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.9% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: High number of new directors
news.body: There are 6 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. Additional Non-Executive Independent Director Sandip Sharma was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2026. The company’s lack of board continuity is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: Asston Pharmaceuticals Limited Announces Directorate Appointments, Effective March 30, 2026
news.body: Asston Pharmaceuticals Limited, at the board meeting held on 30 March, 2026 appointed Mr. Yashvardhan Tupe as Additional Non-Executive Director of the Company with effect from March 30, 2026. Mr. Yashvardhan Tupe holds a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering (B.E. Mechanical Engineering) and a Master of Science (M.Sc.) in Management and International Business. With a strong academic background and relevant exposure, particularly aligned with the operational and strategic aspects of the manufacturing industry, the proposed appointee is expected to contribute effectively to the Company’s growth, governance framework, and long-term business strategy. news.title: Asston Pharmaceuticals Limited Appoints Sumit Pawar as Chief Financial Officer, Effective March 30, 2026
news.body: Asston Pharmaceuticals Limited, at the board meeting held on 30 March, 2026 appointed Mr. Sumit Pawar as Chief Financial Officer of the Company with effect from March 30, 2026. Mr. Sumit Pawar is a Commerce graduate having a rich experience of over 3 years in the field of finance & accounting management. He has an understanding of diverse business processes and strategy development. His association with the Company shall be valuable to build financial models and implement plans and strategies that promote the attainment of reasonably set company goals. His experience shall provide operational and financial efficacy to the company.
